cases.explain: «Пресных хлебов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.

cases.sentence: Они прошли мимо первой стражи, потом мимо второй и подошли к ___, ведущим в город.
cases.explain: «железным воротам» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out, and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.

cases.sentence: Наутро среди солдат произошло ___, никто не знал, что случилось с Петром.
cases.explain: «большое замешательство» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.
